metaDescription: Bichon Frise vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Bichon Frise boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Bichon Frise social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Bichon Frise exposure.

Weight range 12-18 lb (5-8 kg) and grooming needs (Regular professional grooming; coat mats without brushing.) belong in the same Bichon Frise household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Bichon Frise is also monitored for patellar luxation, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Bichon Frise appointments.
After the Bichon Frise puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Bichon Frise misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Bichon Frise series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Bichon Frise is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Bichon Frise away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Bichon Frise due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Bichon Frise core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Bichon Frise misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Bichon Frise health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Bichon Frise adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
